audit_items.proof_trace: The middleware exclusively authenticates kiosk access by reading the token from the URL query parameter (`searchParams.get('token')`, L7-8); there is no header- or cookie-based alternative. Every request to `/kiosk` requires `?token=<KIOSK_ACCESS_TOKEN>` in the URL, meaning the secret appears in server access logs, browser history, the visible address bar on the physical kiosk device, and any Referer headers sent on outbound requests from the page.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker with access to web server access logs, network traffic, or physical visibility of the kiosk device's browser URL bar can extract the `KIOSK_ACCESS_TOKEN` and remotely load the kiosk page to record fake attendance entries or trigger unauthorized NFC card registrations.
